EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows two sharp bands in the nitrile region (2255 and 2297 cm⁻¹), consistent with two distinct C≡N stretches. Candidate 9 contains two nitrile-type groups (N#C and C#N), which can yield multiple CN stretching bands (supports GFQ-030). The strong C–H stretches at 2945 and 3006 cm⁻¹ and a CH deformation near 1375 cm⁻¹ match aliphatic CH vibrations (GFQ-003). Candidates with only one nitrile (e.g., 2) or with terminal alkynes (which should show ≈3300 cm⁻¹ C≡C–H) are less consistent; candidate 2 also implies a carbonyl band near 1650–1750 cm⁻¹, not observed.
